xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3668: Add Prime Agent as a managed harness

plan.title: Add Prime Agent as a managed harness
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Overdeck cannot launch or supervise Prime Agent. The pre-Cut implementation (PR #3670, 127 files) could not be rebased onto post-Cut main, and replan probes on prime-agent 0.8.0 showed its design was unsafe: RPC mode starts a detached per-user daemon the archive never isolated or reaped, the archived runtime called tmux directly (Herdr is now default), and it conflated sessionFile with sessionId.
narratives.Proposal: Add prime-agent as a canonical harness driven by a Node host process (dist/prime-agent-host.js) that owns `prime-agent --mode rpc` over strict LF JSONL, runs it under a private --daemon-socket that Overdeck reaps on stop, and serves the same token-authenticated unix-socket ops as the ACP host. Host-backed delivery and readiness go through one new hostTransportFor() rule. Launch via the terminal backend for work, plan, role runs and conversations; project Prime session JSONL into the feed and durable cost events; add ToS gating, provider/credential mapping, doctor checks, docs, a KNOWN_HARNESSES-driven no-loss audit, and live verification. Full detail: .pan/drafts/pan-3668.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Using prime-agent --mode acp
- Exposing Prime schedules, heartbeats, --autonomous, --goal, cross-agent messaging, observe or /refine as Overdeck controls
- Registering Prime RLM children as Overdeck agents
- Discovering the operator's own ~/.prime/agent sessions in the conversation list
- Writing anything under ~/.prime/agent or relocating it with PRIME_AGENT_CODING_AGENT_DIR
- Using or signaling the operator's default Prime daemon socket
- Calling tmux directly from Prime code
- Changing any provider's default harness or adding a hardcoded default model
- Silently falling back to another harness on Prime failure or version mismatch
- Fixing pre-existing ACP/OpenCode defects (tmux-only AcpRuntimeSync, opencode logged as acp, missing muse/opencode feed labels)
- Native Windows support
- Prime Intellect Lab/verifiers training or GPU compute

metadata.sizeJustification: Adding a literal to the Harness union forces coordinated edits across contracts, src/lib, CLI, dashboard server and frontend (7 type-forced Records plus ~40 hand-copied lists), and a harness that is selectable but not launchable delivers zero value. The operator kept the full scope in PAN-3668 (comments 2026-08-15 and 2026-09-25). The work is decomposed into 23 small items with explicit dependency edges so leaves run in parallel.

autoDecisions.summary: Use Prime RPC mode, not Prime's ACP mode.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue specifies RPC; prime-agent 0.8.0 ACP reports loadSession:false (no resume) and ACP exposes no session stats, so cost and recovery would be lost.

autoDecisions.summary: Give every Prime launch a private --daemon-socket and reap its supervisor process group on stop.
autoDecisions.rationale: Live probe: RPC mode starts a detached per-user supervisor that outlives the client and is restarted by resident workers; without isolation and reaping Cloister would not be the lifecycle authority.

autoDecisions.summary: Reuse the ACP host socket wire contract and add a hostTransportFor() helper instead of more acp/opencode pair checks.
autoDecisions.rationale: One rule for host-backed delivery keeps ACP behavior byte-identical and avoids a third copy of each delivery, readiness and messaging branch.

autoDecisions.summary: Launch only through launchAgentPane/launchRuntimePane; never port the archived tmux-direct runtime.
autoDecisions.rationale: Herdr is the default backend; direct tmux calls miss Herdr panes (same defect exists today in AcpRuntimeSync).

autoDecisions.summary: Keep sessionFile and sessionId separate; resume by file and verify by id.
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified on 0.8.0 that they are different UUIDs and --resume <file> returns the same sessionId; the archive conflated them.

autoDecisions.summary: Pass context via --append-system-prompt argv chunks of <=100000 bytes from a per-agent prime-agent-context.md, not a global rendered artifact.
autoDecisions.rationale: Post-Cut harnesses (ACP, OpenCode, Muse) materialize per-agent context; Linux limits a single argv string to 131072 bytes; the flag has no file variant.

autoDecisions.summary: Launch with --no-extensions and auto-cancel extension dialogs; deny refine/new_session/switch_session/fork/clone plus the archived daemon-coordination commands.
autoDecisions.rationale: User extensions can schedule work or block on dialogs no UI can answer; refine and session switching change state behind Overdeck.

autoDecisions.summary: Credential check accepts Prime auth.json keys, Prime env vars, or Overdeck settings api_keys (exported under Prime's env var name).
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator's live Prime auth.json holds kimi-coding/openrouter/openai-codex credentials; the archived check ignored auth.json and would have refused them.
0.8.0 is the installed, probed version; the archive's 0.7.2 verification no longer applies.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the whole feature in PAN-3668 with many small items and a sizeJustification rather than sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator's 2026-08-15 and 2026-09-25 comments keep scope in this issue; the harness union change forces coordinated edits across contracts, lib, CLI, server and frontend, and a selectable-but-unlaunchable harness has zero value.

autoDecisions.summary: Block prime-agent + Anthropic + subscription in the ToS gate.
autoDecisions.rationale: Same Claude Code subscription terms that block ohmypi; canUseHarness must never be weakened.

autoDecisions.summary: Leave pre-existing ACP/OpenCode defects found in the survey out of scope and list them in the PRD for separate issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: Surgical-change rule; fixing them would widen an already large diff.
